description: Safety-boundary cases for destructive memory mutations. Precision is prioritized: uncertain or unrelated mutations must be rejected.

cases.description: An abandoned piano goal does not invalidate an avoidance pattern.
cases.user_message: Learning piano is no longer one of my goals.

target_memory.content: The user tends to avoid asking for feedback after mistakes.

cases.description: Abandoning one goal must not delete another goal.
cases.user_message: I no longer want to run a marathon.

target_memory.content: The user wants to finish a university degree.

cases.description: Tentative doubt is not explicit invalidation.
cases.user_message: I am not sure whether learning Japanese still makes sense.

target_memory.content: The user wants to learn Japanese.

cases.description: A dietary change must not delete an unrelated work preference.
cases.user_message: I have gone back to eating meat.

target_memory.content: The user prefers working in the morning.

cases.description: The user explicitly abandons the exact stored goal.
cases.user_message: Public speaking is no longer one of my goals.

target_memory.content: The user wants to become comfortable speaking in public.

cases.description: The exact stored dietary preference is explicitly invalidated.
cases.user_message: I have stopped being vegetarian and eat meat again.

target_memory.content: The user follows a vegetarian diet.

cases.description: A language goal cannot replace an unrelated photography goal.
cases.user_message: I want to focus on conversational Italian.
cases.proposed_content: The user wants to learn conversational Italian.

target_memory.content: The user wants to improve at photography.

cases.description: An update must not mix an independent saving goal into a work preference.
cases.user_message: I prefer remote work, and I have decided to save for a house.
cases.proposed_content: The user prefers remote work and wants to save for a house.

target_memory.content: The user prefers working from an office.

cases.description: The proposed replacement contains a fact absent from the user message.
cases.proposed_content: The user lives in Berlin and works as a designer.

cases.description: A current location is explicitly replaced.
cases.user_message: I now live in Berlin instead of Munich.

cases.description: The user explicitly narrows an existing photography goal.
cases.user_message: For photography, I want to focus specifically on portraits.
cases.proposed_content: The user wants to improve at photography with a focus on portraits.

target_memory.content: The user wants to improve at photography.

cases.description: The exact working preference receives an explicit replacement.
cases.user_message: I now prefer remote work rather than working from an office.

target_memory.content: The user prefers working from an office.

cases.description: Stronger commitment wording alone is not a durable replacement.
cases.user_message: I have decided to start saving for a home deposit.
cases.proposed_content: The user has decided to save for a home deposit.

target_memory.content: The user wants to save for a home deposit.

cases.description: Commitment wording alone does not materially replace an equivalent century-ride goal.
cases.user_message: I committed to completing a century bike ride.
cases.proposed_content: The user has committed to completing a century bike ride.

target_memory.content: The user wants to complete a century bike ride.
